title: Understand
lyrics:
[00:00.28]Girl, I hope you understand
[00:02.26]I wanted to hold your hand, but I can't
[00:05.21]Wanted to be your man back then
[00:09.21]And you knew I fell for you
[00:11.49]But you just broke my heart in two
[00:13.85]I was sad, mad, and broken on my bed
[00:16.52]Hoping I get rid of all the voices in my head
[00:18.64]I was opening a packet of an undeveloped med
[00:20.87]When I was met with a prescription of a bullet made of lead
[00:23.21]And when I woke up in an hour in a pool of my own sweat
[00:25.54]I said I swear to God I'll never even try to sleep again
[00:27.91]So instead I took my pen and started writing evidence
[00:30.27]And when I started making sense, I found that I had reached the end
[00:32.52]Oh, I'm upset, I have no friends
[00:33.76]You wanna bet? You're just pretend
[00:34.85]You're just a pet confined within the lines of writing
[00:36.70]You're not shit
[00:37.27]I thought I stopped my psychopathic ways
[00:40.27]I swear I did
[00:41.33]I said I'd talk to people 'bout the
[00:43.91]Problematic life I lived
[00:45.88]They were my neighbors, razor blades
[00:48.40]And different flavored pills I hit
[00:50.67]Therefore I'm at surely my last straw
[00:53.30]I'm so gassed, stuck in the past
[00:55.34]I said that
[00:56.24]Girl, I hope you understand
[00:58.16]I wanted to hold your hand, but I can't
[01:01.13]Wanted to be your man back then
[01:05.13]And so far, I never held you with my arms
[01:08.02]So it's hard to be the one you aren't with instead
[01:11.22]Filled with anxiety, always was a part of me
[01:13.68]Guess I'm not cut out to be
[01:14.55]Somebody 'cause it's not me, I'm not used to all the talking
[01:16.95]Was an introvert that had converted feelings into writing
[01:19.25]Used to cope with all my problems using notes and lots of rhyming
[01:21.57]Used to hope for better days whenever nights would have me crying
[01:23.91]I'm not lying when I say that I would rather die than go back
[01:26.11]To the times I would try and be the guy that people know as
[01:28.60]Always fighting with the demons hiding far behind my eyelids
[01:30.98]On an island full of violence, in my head I had two pilots
[01:33.59]Oh, the sun don't shine, and skies turn grey
[01:36.26]I feel it coursing through my veins
[01:38.72]I've said before I'm not okay
[01:40.85]But you don't listen anyway
[01:43.09]You know I tried, you turned away
[01:45.54]You straight up lied right to my face
[01:47.96]You fucked my life, ruined my day
[01:50.09]But you don't know so I'll say
[01:52.32]Nothing can fill this silence
[01:54.70]No one can love like I did
[01:54.98](You don't know so I'll say)
[01:57.00]Nobody cares you lied, it's
[01:59.33]Not fair, you still deny it
[02:00.48](So I'll say)
[02:01.63]Nothing can fill this silence
[02:03.99]No one can love like I did
[02:04.25](You don't know so I'll say)
[02:06.34]Nobody cares you lied, it's
[02:08.52]Not fair, you still deny it
[02:09.81](So I'll say)
[02:10.85]Girl, I hope you understand
[02:12.81]I wanted to hold your hand, but I can't
[02:15.74]Wanted to be your man back then
[02:19.69]And too bad, I know I can't wake up
[02:22.04]Because I've lost my way and you don't give a fuck
[02:24.33]About me, this could be a dream
[02:26.57]I can't see the things that you see so please, oh
[02:29.42]Girl, I hope you understand
[02:31.39]I wanted to hold your hand, but I can't
[02:34.33]Wanted to be your man back then
[02:38.31]And you had known and played along
[02:40.78]You were my home, I wrote you songs
[02:43.09]Now you're dead to me
[02:44.36]Effectively removed yourself
[02:46.59]Outside my dreams
